11:52 Local Time, 15:52 GMT, 21:22 IST -- Lunch, Day 2: This is more than a competitive total from West Indies. When Ali Usman got his very first ball to rip sharply in the ninth over yesterday, the hosts would have gladly taken 344. They resumed the day on 239/5, but Greaves fell to the very first delivery with the second new ball. Chase kept the scoreboard moving, brought up a gritty fifty and added a useful stand with Roach before Ubaid Shah cleaned him up. There were handy contributions from the lower order as well, helping West Indies add 106 runs this morning and push the total close to the 350-mark. Sajid Khan was Pakistan's standout bowler with a four-fer, well supported by Ali Usman. The two spinners shared six wickets between them and shouldered the bulk of the workload.
